title: Change an Engine Air Filter
summary: A clogged filter chokes the engine. Five minutes under the hood, big difference.

learn.heading: What you're looking at
learn.body: The engine air filter sits in a plastic box (the air filter housing) along the air intake tube. Clips or screws hold the lid. Inside is a rectangular or round pleated filter element. A dirty filter looks gray or clogged with debris; a new one is off-white and clean.

learn.heading: What can hurt you
learn.body: Engine should be cool — a hot manifold can burn you. Disconnect nothing electrical for a basic filter swap. Don't drop debris into the open housing once the lid is off; anything that falls in gets sucked toward the engine.
learn.callout: Note how the old filter sits before you pull it. The new one goes in the same direction.

learn.heading: The steps
learn.body:
1. Engine off and cool. Hood propped open.
2. Locate the air filter housing — follow the big intake tube from the front grille.
3. Release clips or loosen screws on the housing lid.
4. Lift the lid and note filter orientation.
5. Pull out the old filter. Wipe debris from the housing with a damp cloth if needed.
6. Drop in the new filter, same orientation as the old one.
7. Close the lid, secure clips or screws. Make sure the lid seals — gaps let unfiltered air in.
8. Done. Check your owner's manual for the replacement interval.

practice.prompt: Tap what you open to reach the filter.
practice.failMessage: The filter lives in the air filter housing — not the oil cap or radiator.

options.text: New filter installed backwards — airflow arrow points the wrong way

options.feedback: A clean housing is correct, not a problem.
Clips secured is exactly what you want.

practice.failMessage: Filters have a direction. The pleats face the airflow arrow toward the engine.

practice.prompt: Put the filter swap steps in order.

steps.text: Remove old filter and note orientation
Close and latch the housing lid

practice.failMessage: Open, pull old, drop new in the same way, latch shut. Simple sequence.
